name: steam-workshop-helper-mcp
description: Local MCP server for managing Steam Workshop comments and item descriptions via the Steam Workshop Helper Chrome extension.
long_description: Exposes the Steam Workshop Helper extension's window.SWH API as MCP tools: read Steam login state, list/post/delete workshop comments, and read/update item titles and descriptions. The server runs locally and reaches the extension over a 127.0.0.1 loopback bridge — it never talks to the network and holds no Steam credentials of its own; all actions run against the logged-in Steam session in the browser. Requires the Steam Workshop Helper Chrome extension to be installed and a steamcommunity.com tab open.

tools.name: swh_open_item
tools.description: Open/focus a browser tab directly on a workshop item (works logged in or not).

tools.name: swh_get_auth
tools.description: Report Steam login state as seen by the browser.

tools.name: swh_get_context
tools.description: Metadata about the workshop item open in the active tab.

tools.name: swh_list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a workshop item.

tools.name: swh_post_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a workshop item (BBCode).

tools.name: swh_delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment by its gidcomment id.

tools.name: swh_get_item
tools.description: Read a workshop item's editable title/description/visibility.

tools.name: swh_update_description
tools.description: Replace a workshop item's full description (BBCode).

bridge_port.title: Loopback Bridge Port
bridge_port.description: TCP port on 127.0.0.1 the extension connects to. Must match the port in the extension's manifest host_permissions (default 8766).
